往返时间从同一站的一次发车量到下一次发车，包含去程、回程、装卸、等待和堵车。每节: Measure between consecutive departures from the same station, including travel, transfers and waits. Each wagon needs a matching platform at both ends. Locomotives do not count as wagons.
接口合计按一个站台填写，最多同方向两条带／管。多车厢自动乘站台数。选择物品时载入: Enter capacity per platform, up to two belts or pipes in one direction. Wagon count multiplies platform capacity. Item selection loads its stack size; adjust capacities for other game versions or mods.
均匀发车，所有列车编组相同，每圈在装、卸站各停靠一次；没有其他线路争用站台。班次: Assumes evenly spaced, identical trains, one visit to each endpoint per round trip and no competing routes. Headway H = round-trip seconds / train count; platform availability F = 1 − transfer pause / H.
单车厢每分钟有效运力 = min（容量 × 60 ÷ H，装货接口合计 × F，: Effective rate per wagon = min(capacity × 60 / H, loading interface × F, unloading interface × F). Each platform loses one pause per arrival. Measured round-trip time already includes both endpoint transfers.
固体容量为 32 格 × 堆叠上限。流体默认 2400 m³；旧版可手动改为 1: Solid capacity = 32 slots × stack size. Fluid default = 2400 m³ (change to 1600 for older versions). Default transfer pause = 27.08 sec. Stack sizes use bundled game Docs.
结果是稳定运行的理论上限。增开列车后应重新测量往返时间；不模拟铁路信号、坡度、牵: Results are steady-state theoretical limits. Remeasure the round trip after adding trains. Signals, slopes, traction, mixed cargo, competing routes and fluid sloshing are not simulated. Provide external buffers and sufficient belt/pipe capacity.
